borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
description: External alterations to include: demolition of existing sun room and erection of a replacement extension at first floor level, erection of a rear extension including infilling of the existing undercroft at upper ground floor level; partial demolition and re-building of the lower ground floor including lowering the floor level, excavation of part of the rear garden and erection of a single storey rear extension and lowering the floor level; refurbish existing windows, replacing elements like-for-like, remove paint and render previously applied to the rear; replace uPVC rainwater goods with cast metal; removal of rear staircase; front elevation: remove concrete surface to the front garden and replace with stone slabs; replace uPVC downpipes with cast metal, remove detracting boiler flue, refurbish existing windows and removing variations in glazing, replace mismatched assortment of front railings with a single consistent style incorporating railings and finial details; Internal alterations to include, 2nd Floor: Reconfigure partition wall, re-locating existing doors, install secondary glazing over bathroom window; 1st floor: restore front window, remove detracting tiles and secondary glazing, relocate fireplace from rear room to upper ground floor room, relocate doorway between front and rear rooms, replace double doors with a sliding door, upgrade sanitary fittings in bathroom, install extract fan, venting into existing chimney; upper ground floor: install fireplace to living room; lower ground floor: lower the floor level, rebuild lower flight of staircase, replace non-original doors with panelled doors, replace kitchen units & built-in cupboards, create new waste connection underfloor; remove built-in cupboards at all floor levels, reinstate shutters to street-facing window on 1st and 2nd floors, refurbish skirting doors and architraves on selected floors, reinstate nibs of spine wall on upper and lower ground floors, associated internal & external alterations.
